vision_report.narrative_description: The monitoring sequence began with a split view showing a partially obscured black pot (P2) on the left and a water-propagated Money Plant in a white cup on the right. This arrangement remained stable through T-3, with the minor addition of a background object in T-3. A major intervention occurred at T-2: the camera or pots were repositioned to focus exclusively on P2. This shift revealed that the Mexican Mint is a highly successful, dense, and healthy succulent specimen. After a near-total loss of light in T-1, the CURRENT image confirms that the Mexican Mint remains in excellent, turgid health under the cool LED light, while the Money Plant remains out of frame.
